title: Contact LegalCostGuides
description: Email LegalCostGuides for corrections, questions about our planning kits, purchase support or privacy requests. We cannot give legal advice.
body:
Email

The fastest way to reach us is javiperezguides@gmail.com. We usually reply within 2 business days.

  • Corrections: include the page, the exact sentence and the official source.
  • Purchases and downloads: include the email used at checkout. You can also re-send your download link yourself.
  • Privacy requests: say which right you want to exercise (access, deletion, correction).

We cannot help with your legal case

LegalCostGuides is not a law firm. Please do not send case details, documents or deadlines: we cannot advise on them and emailing us does not protect your rights. If you need help now, use your state's legal aid program or a state bar lawyer referral service.
